selected_evidence.requirement: Initial node1 primary with node2 and node3 replicas; infra:proof=ready stored
selected_evidence.summary: node1 reported master with two online replicas; both replicas had healthy links. SET succeeded and WAIT received two replica acknowledgements.
Every Sentinel identified node1 as the initial primary, saw two replicas and two peer Sentinels, and reported three usable Sentinels with quorum available.

selected_evidence.requirement: Authenticated TLS on cache-network ports and node1 administrative credentials
selected_evidence.summary: Plaintext and certificate-less access were rejected; unauthenticated mTLS returned NOAUTH; authenticated Redis and Sentinel requests returned PONG under verified TLS 1.3. Final listeners are bound to each cache IP, and node1's credential file is root-owned mode 0600.

selected_evidence.requirement: Automatic promotion during primary outage and recovered former primary synchronized as replica
selected_evidence.summary: Healthy baseline preceded stopping only node1 Redis. Its Sentinel remained active and quorum remained intact. node3 was automatically elected, retained the proof value, accepted and replicated a new write, and logs recorded the complete election and switch-master sequence. After restoration, node1 reported replica of node3 with link up, synchronization complete, equal read/replication offsets, and both pre-outage and outage-written data present.

selected_evidence.requirement: Final healthy and persistent service state
selected_evidence.summary: Redis and Sentinel are active and enabled everywhere. All Sentinels agree on node3, node3 has node1 and node2 online at matching offsets, quorum is healthy, and infra:proof remains ready on every node.
